杨云帆走上前，目光微微一瞥，发现地上那女子竟然是个大美女。
那个女子有一头栗色的长发，长发有些微卷看起来就如海藻一般柔顺。她画着淡妆，嘴唇就像水晶一样发出润泽的光芒。
原本，这样的大美女应该是像仙女一样高高在上，不食人间烟火的。可是现在，她那艳丽如同玫瑰的容颜，此时正血流如注。面色随着血液流逝，渐渐发白，不过一会儿就有泛起了青气。
糟糕，这女人的面色不大对劲。
“安静，现在，我要开始为她检查。”杨云帆示意众人安静下来。他的话语里有一种让人难以违抗的魔力。这一刻，所有人都安静的屏住了呼吸，生怕一说话，打扰了杨云帆的救治。
杨云帆一摸女子的脉搏，他的眉头就紧皱起来。
这女子双目紧闭，面色苍白，脉搏细速，呼吸浅快，双手一片冰冷。而且，脉搏越来越弱，就快要消失不见了。
“糟糕！这女子出血太多，体温下降的厉害。这是要休克的症状！”杨云帆只是简单的摸了一下女子的脉搏，再用“观气法”看了一下女子的气色，很快就得出了结论！
“嗯，好疼。”就在这时，这名女子经过短暂的昏迷，却忽然清醒过来。
那名女警察一看到那受伤女子醒过来，顿时大喜道，“太好了！她醒过来了。”
她一喊，众人都纷纷围过来。那个叫许强的凶恶男子更是三步并作两步的跑过来，激动道：“林姐，你醒过来了，太好了。”
许强转过头就要对着杨云帆感恩，道：“谢谢医生……”
可是他动作还没有做完，就被杨云帆一把拦住了。只见杨云帆的面色严肃，丝毫没有一点喜悦。
许强不由心头一沉，忐忑道，“医生，林姐她……”
杨云帆摸着那个女子的脉搏，又用手轻轻撑开那女子的眼睑，不断的观察她瞳孔的变化。
只是，越观察，他的神情却越加严肃。
“短暂的昏迷，继而意识转为清醒，过一会儿，她可能会再次昏迷。并且期间伴有头痛、呕吐、烦躁不安、肢体无力等症状……”
杨云帆一边说，那个女子仿佛为了印证杨云帆的话一般。在清醒过来之后片刻，就开始喊头痛，并且大口大口的呕吐出粘稠的物体，紧跟着，她眼睛的瞳孔开始扩大，嘴巴大口喘息，全身出汗，看起来非常烦躁不安。而过了不到两分钟，她又再次昏迷了过去。
“这……”

众人起先听到杨云帆的话，此时再一看女子的反映，顿时惊得目瞪口呆。他说的一切，居然和女子之后表现出来的症状，完全符合。
这简直是神医啊！
瞬间，杨云帆在众人的眼中，就变得神秘莫测起来。
所有人都震惊的看着杨云帆，被他那无比精确的诊断所征服。可是，杨云帆的脸上非但没有任何喜悦，反而面容紧绷，有种说不出的紧迫感。
只听杨云帆继续说道：“她的头部在刚刚的车祸中，遭受了外力严重打击，产生了颅内骨折或者颅骨局部变形，使得她脑膜中的血管破裂，所以才会产生以上的症状。她现在患的应该是，急性硬膜外血肿！”
“她的这种症状，必须在半个小时内接受手术。最迟也要在一个小时内完成手术。否则，会有性命危险。”
“什么？”听了杨云帆的话，那许强脸色顿时一片惨白。
他抓着杨云帆的手，近乎哀求道：“医生，求求你救救林姐吧。既然你能看出什么症状，一定也能救她的，对不对？”
许强说完，直接拉着杨云帆的手不放开。生怕一放开，杨云帆就跑了。摊上这种倒霉事，大部分医生都会跑。反正又没送到医院，关自己屁事。
“唉，好吧。我试试吧。”
杨云帆叹了一口气，走到那女子旁边，拉起她的手，微微一运功，一丝不可察觉的紫色灵气，便顺着她手腕上的穴位，进入经脉之中。而后，开始游走她的全身。
随后，杨云帆检查了一下，发现那女子头颅里面的淤血肿块，渐渐的消失，淤血也散去，生命力逐渐旺盛起来，就跟没受伤一样。
他满意的站起来道：“嗯，好了，她应该没事了。”
“就这么摸几下，就没事了？我读书少，你别骗我！”许强可怎么也不相信，杨云帆只是摸了摸他老板的手，就能治好她。

Yang Yunfan stepped forward, glanced slightly, and found that the woman on the ground turned out to be a beautiful woman.
The woman had long chestnut hair, which was slightly curly and looked as smooth as seaweed. She wore light makeup, and her lips glowed like crystals.
Originally, such a beautiful woman was supposed to be as aloof as a fairy, aloof from the world. But now, her face, as beautiful as a rose, was bleeding profusely. As the blood flowed away, his complexion gradually turned white, but after a while, he became green.
Oops, this woman doesn't look right.
"Quiet, now I'm going to start checking her." Yang Yunfan signaled everyone to quiet down. There is a magic in his words that is hard to resist. At this moment, everyone held their breath quietly, for fear that speaking would disturb Yang Yunfan's treatment.
Yang Yunfan frowned as soon as he felt the woman's pulse.
The woman's eyes were closed tightly, her face was pale, her pulse was thin and her breathing was shallow and fast, and her hands were cold. Moreover, the pulse became weaker and weaker and almost disappeared.
"Oops! This woman is bleeding too much and her body temperature has dropped sharply. This is a sign of shock!" Yang Yunfan simply touched the woman's pulse, then used the "Qi Observation Method" to check the woman's complexion, and quickly came to a conclusion!
"Well, it hurts." At this moment, the woman suddenly woke up after a brief coma.
When the female police officer saw the injured woman waking up, she was overjoyed and said, "Great! She woke up."
As soon as she shouted, everyone gathered around her. The ferocious man named Xu Qiang ran over in three steps and said excitedly: "Sister Lin, you woke up, it's great."
Xu Qiang turned his head to thank Yang Yunfan and said, "Thank you, doctor..."
But before he finished his move, he was stopped by Yang Yunfan. Yang Yunfan's face was serious and there was no joy at all.
Xu Qiang couldn't help but his heart sank, and he said anxiously, "Doctor, Sister Lin..."
Yang Yunfan felt the woman's pulse, then gently opened the woman's eyelids with his hand, constantly observing the changes in her pupils.
However, the more he observed, the more serious his expression became.
"She went into a brief coma, and then became conscious. After a while, she may become comatose again. During this period, she would be accompanied by symptoms such as headache, vomiting, irritability, and limb weakness..."
As Yang Yunfan spoke, the woman seemed to be trying to confirm Yang Yunfan's words. Moments after waking up, she began to complain of a headache and vomited thick objects in large mouthfuls. Immediately afterwards, the pupils of her eyes began to dilate, her mouth gasped for breath, and her whole body was sweating. She looked very irritable and restless. Less than two minutes later, she passed out again.
"This..."
Everyone heard Yang Yunfan's words at first, but when they saw the woman's reaction, they were stunned. Everything he said was completely consistent with the symptoms the woman showed later.
This is simply a miracle cure!
In an instant, Yang Yunfan became mysterious and unpredictable in the eyes of everyone.
Everyone looked at Yang Yunfan in shock, conquered by his extremely accurate diagnosis. However, instead of showing any joy on Yang Yunfan's face, his face was tense, with an indescribable sense of urgency.
Just listen to Yang Yunfan continue to say: "Her head suffered a severe blow from an external force in the car accident just now, resulting in an intracranial fracture or local deformation of the skull, which caused the blood vessels in her meninges to rupture, which is why she has the above symptoms. She should be suffering from acute epidural hematoma now!"
"She has such symptoms that she must undergo surgery within half an hour. The surgery must be completed within an hour at the latest. Otherwise, life may be in danger. "
"What? "After hearing Yang Yunfan's words, Xu Qiang's face suddenly turned pale.
He grabbed Yang Yunfan's hand and almost begged: "Doctor, please save Sister Lin. Since you can see the symptoms, you can definitely save her, right? "
After Xu Qiang finished speaking, he directly took Yang Yunfan's hand and refused to let go. He was afraid that Yang Yunfan would run away as soon as he let go. If something bad like this happens, most doctors will run away. It's none of his business since he wasn't sent to the hospital anyway.
"Oh, okay. I'll give it a try. "
Yang Yunfan sighed, walked to the woman's side, took her hand, and with a slight movement of energy, a trace of imperceptible purple spiritual energy followed the acupuncture points on her wrist and entered the meridians. Then, it began to travel throughout her body.
Later, Yang Yunfan checked and found that the congestion and swelling in the woman's head gradually disappeared, the congestion also dispersed, and her vitality gradually became stronger, as if she was not injured.
He stood up with satisfaction and said: "Well, okay, she should be fine. "
"Just touch it a few times and everything will be fine? I don’t read much, don’t lie to me! "Xu Qiang didn't believe that Yang Yunfan could cure his boss just by touching her hand.
